# Machine-learning projections and picks for NBA, WNBA, MLB, NFL & NHL player props.

::: hero-lede
Slam Dunk Bets is a subscription picks service run by data scientists and engineers. Our machine learning models project first-basket props for every NBA and WNBA game, home runs and NRFI/YRFI for every MLB game, and touchdown and goal scorers for every NFL and NHL game, compare them to sportsbook prices every 30 minutes, and post the edges to Discord with unit sizes. Every bet is tracked and graded in public.
:::
